provider.notes: Registered at gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:1784; dispatched at gateway/src/core/stt/standard.rs:430-432. MODEL KEY: the model id is Huawei's 'property' string, which encodes language, sample rate and domain; there is no separate model or language parameter. An empty model resolves to chinese_16k_general (gateway/src/core/stt/huawei_cloud/config.rs:40, fallback at :230). The gateway accepts a region suffix on the model, for example chinese_16k_general@cn-north-4 (config.rs:777-783; key_normalisation), and an unrecognised region silently becomes cn-north-4 (config.rs:779). REGIONS: region limits of the short-audio interface are region constraints on the file transports; those of the real-time socket stay in each row's provenance notes. Documented SIS hosts are sis-ext.cn-north-4, sis-ext.cn-east-3, sis-ext.ap-southeast-3 and sis-ext.me-east-1. The gateway's region list (config.rs:75-91) has ap-southeast-1 and ap-southeast-2, which the vendor does not list for SIS, and lacks me-east-1. STREAMING CLIENT (adapter native, known_broken; read from code, vendor documentation and DNS, never run against the vendor; all paths under gateway/src/core/stt/huawei_cloud/): (1) China regions dial sis.{region}.myhuaweicloud.com (config.rs:25, :128-134); that host is absent from DNS for cn-north-4 and cn-east-3, so the socket cannot connect there, and the Bangkok region in the gateway's list has no SIS host at all. (2) The parser expects resp_type STARTED and ENDED, a top-level 'result' and an integer error_code (messages.rs:219-260); the vendor sends START, EVENT, RESULT with segments[].result, and string codes such as SIS.0002, so a real result yields no transcript and a real error fails to parse. (3) Only the one-sentence mode /rasr/short-stream is reachable (config.rs:387-388; nothing sets the mode); it has a one-minute limit and no vendor end-of-speech detection, and END is sent only at shutdown (client.rs:158-163). A call needs /rasr/continue-stream (5 hours, vendor end-of-speech detection). (4) Unknown model ids become chinese_16k_general (config.rs:230), and STTConfig.language and sample_rate are never read (config.rs:762-798). (5) Model aliases written with a hyphen can never match: from_str replaces '-' with '_' before it compares (config.rs:213), but the arms still spell zh-cn, zh-yue, zh-sichuan and zh-minnan (config.rs:214-224), so 'zh-yue' becomes Mandarin. The repository mock (gateway/tests/mock_endpoint_e2e.rs:1628, :1652) uses the same undocumented schema, so its passing test covers none of this. PER-UTTERANCE SOCKET (adapter planned_commit, which no release builds; inferred from the documentation): the one-sentence mode ignores vad_head, vad_tail and max_seconds and returns the final result shortly after the client's END, which makes it a per-utterance primitive the gateway's own detector can drive. Whether one WebSocket may carry several START and END cycles is unverified, so plan for a connection per utterance. An idle socket is closed with SIS.0304. FILE UPLOAD (adapter regional_rest, not implemented): recognize_short_audio (client.rs:705-770) builds the documented JSON request but has no caller, returns text only (dropping score and word_info, client.rs:766-769), and belongs to a client mode that buffers without limit and never flushes (client.rs:891-894). Its URL comes from get_short_asr_url (config.rs:680-687), which shares the dead China host. MAX_SHORT_AUDIO_DURATION_SECS is 30 (config.rs:52) while the vendor limit is one minute. Each client instance logs in with a password; a process-wide token cache is needed. Treat SIS.0312 (concurrency exceeded) as back-pressure. The '4 MB' limit is recorded with the decimal reading, the lower one. STATE TODAY: the streaming client is the native transport, enabled from Release 0, groundwork and honest refusal, and reported as known broken in ready.stt rather than refused (integration decisions, section 15); each native transport carries its defect. The file transport (regional_rest) is enabled from Release 5, wider vendor coverage and hardening, and only after a live probe with a real key (decisions section 12). Until then a model the gateway has no working path for is refused or warned as its when_unusable says. Segmentation is required for chinese_16k_travel, english_16k_common and english_8k_common; the last is a model the vendor no longer maintains and is marked legacy. The gateway's speech-to-text feature table has no huawei-cloud row, and config/pricing.rs has no Huawei entries, so rows carry no pricing_key.
